name: integrator complex subunit 12

function.text: INTS12 is the approved symbol for integrator complex subunit 12. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in regulation of transcription elongation by RNA polymerase II; RNA polymerase II transcription initiation surveillance.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Lung adenocarcinoma; Multiple myeloma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Historical hotspot cohort observation; individual-allele significance and tumor-specific oncogenicity require review.

function.text: INTS12 encodes integrator complex subunit 12. Its functions include regulation of transcription elongation by RNA polymerase II and RNA polymerase II transcription initiation surveillance.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving INTS12 have been reported in multiple myeloma and lung adenocarcinoma. Recurrence alone does not establish the oncogenicity of an individual variant.
